title: Transport of one finite perfect chart to the normalized residue slice
statement: Let T,S be schemes, g:S→T a morphism, ell prime and E/Q_ell finite. Let d be an adic datum on O_E with ideal generated by the recorded uniformizer, and c an IntegralResidueCoefficientModel on S [lem-weil-pbc-integral-residue-coefficient-model]. Let n≥0, let C be a complex of large finite coefficient module sheaves on T, and let Y be an etale S-object. Suppose the finite derived pullback of Q(C) along Y.hom followed by g is the finiteCoefficientRealization of a constant perfect large finite quotient complex P. Then there is a perfect complex P prime over the small ring O_E/d.ideal^(n+1) whose residueLisseDerivedConstant realization, changed along residueLisseConstantComparison, is isomorphic on the pro-etale slice over Y to integralResidueFiniteModel of the finite pullback of Q(C) along g [lem-weil-pbc-integral-residue-finite-reduction]. This concerns one finite chart; no completed object, completeness, covering, or integral lifting is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.8(1),(2), Lemma 6.6.8 and Proposition 6.6.11; coefficient-presentation comparisons on constant sections and quotient projections.

proof.text: Choose the bounded finite-projective representative V from IsPerfectRingComplex. Restrict scalars along the inverse of the normalized quotient equivalence. Module.Finite.small makes each term small; Shrink.linearEquiv transports the module. Descend the differentials along the fully faithful lift, checking shape and square-zero after applying the faithful functor. The resulting complex B retains the strict bounds and finite-projective terms, and Q(P) is isomorphic to Q(lift B). This is proved in the private smallPerfectModel helper.

Cancel the realization/unrealization units and use upperStarComp to compare the two finite inverse images. Constant sheaf inverse image commutes with constants by the geometric constant-sheaf comparison. Localize these natural isomorphisms and compose with the supplied chart and the algebraic model isomorphism, obtaining an isomorphism between the pullbacks of the original finite object and the constant lifted B on S.

Apply integralResidueFiniteSlice to descend this isomorphism to the normalized ringed slice. Apply the global integralResidueFiniteConstants comparison to B and restrict it exactly to the slice. Compose the slice isomorphisms and pair Q(B) with its already proved perfectness.

proof_origin.place: Section 6.5, Lemma 6.5.8(1),(2), and Proposition 6.6.11; normalized coefficient presentations and localization of ringed sites.

from.place: The integral-lattice step: normalize the completed coefficients and residue models on the fixed stratum before applying the perfect residue lifting theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem integralResidueFiniteChart
    (T S : Scheme.{u}) (g : S ⟶ T) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))
    (hd : d.ideal = Ideal.span {Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E})
    (c : IntegralResidueCoefficientModel l E d S) (n : ℕ)
    (C : CochainComplex
      (FiniteCoefficientModules T (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n)) ℤ)
    (Y : S.Etale)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n)) ℤ)
    (hP : @DerivedCategory.IsPerfectRingComplex (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n) _
      (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
    (eP : Nonempty
      ((finiteCoefficientDerivedPullback T (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n)
          (Y.hom ≫ g)).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) ≅
        (finiteCoefficientRealization Y.left
          (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology Y.left)
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n))).mapHomologicalComplex
                (.up ℤ)).obj P)))) :
    ∃ P' : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u}
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))),
      DerivedCategory.IsPerfectRingComplex P' ∧
      Nonempty
        (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing S d n)
            ((toProEt S).obj Y)
            (integralResidueFiniteModel S l E d c n
              ((finiteCoefficientDerivedPullback T
                (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n) g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C))) ≅
          ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing S d n)
            ((toProEt S).obj Y)
            ((completedAdicDerivedChange S (residueLisseConstantComparison S d n)).obj
              ((residueLisseDerivedConstant S
                (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).obj P')))
